atlasDraft.pZh: 门槛上的盐还在。阿汐没有看它，也没有看海。薄簿合着，页角平整。夜里潮水退去，门外多了一道浅浅的干痕。她没有起身。天亮时，干痕仍在，盐粒旁边空着一处。
atlasDraft.pEn: The salt remained on the threshold. Axi looked neither at it nor at the sea. The ledger was closed, its page corner flat. At night the tide receded, leaving a faint dry mark outside the door. She did not rise. By dawn it remained, with an empty space beside the grain.
atlasDraft.codaZh: 有些页，不必翻开才算留下。
atlasDraft.codaEn: Some pages remain without being opened.
